# Payload Website Template

> A content-driven website built with Payload CMS and Astro. It publishes pages and blog posts managed in the CMS.

Content on this site is publicly readable. The `/api/` paths are internal endpoints and are not intended for crawling.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://www.findb.uk/): Landing page
- [Posts](https://www.findb.uk/posts): Index of all published posts
- [Contact](https://www.findb.uk/contact): Contact form
- [Search](https://www.findb.uk/search): Full-text search across posts

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.findb.uk/sitemap.xml): Every published page and post
- [robots.txt](https://www.findb.uk/robots.txt): Crawl rules
